connection.offlineHint: Changes are not sent. They wait in the device queue.
connection.pollingHint: Data refreshes periodically. Real-time updates are unavailable on this network.

confidence.whyBody: A 0–100 score from verification age, stock movement, last variance, and pending review. It only informs — it never blocks a pick.
confidence.neverCountedNote: Never physically counted — score is capped at 30.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.searchHint: Type to search. Press Ctrl K for quick search.
dashboard.lastTakenEmpty: No picks yet. Search for an item to start.
dashboard.liveEmpty: No activity yet. Other people's actions appear here.
dashboard.needsCountEmpty: Every rack is verified. Nothing to count.
dashboard.offlineQueueEmpty: Queue is empty. Everything is synced.
dashboard.denied: That page is for another role. You were sent home.

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search item name, SKU, or code…
search.noQuery: Type an item name, SKU, or QR code to start searching.
search.emptyBody: Check the spelling or try another word. If it should exist, report it to your supervisor.
search.searchingHint: Results appear after you stop typing.

item.title: Item location
item.scanToTake: Scan the rack QR to pick
item.manualCodeHint: If the QR is damaged, type the code from the label.
item.infoOnly: This page is information only. Picks only happen from the scan page.
item.notFoundBody: The code is unknown or the item was removed. Tell your supervisor if that's wrong.
item.inactiveBody: This item was deactivated by an admin and cannot be picked.
item.errorBody: The signal or the server is having trouble. Try again shortly.

landing.heroBody: Scan the rack QR, enter the quantity, done in 10 seconds. Stock updates on the dashboard instantly, and every pick is recorded permanently.
landing.featuresBody: No long training, no extra app. Just a browser on a phone.
landing.featureLogBody: Every stock change becomes a log row that cannot be edited or deleted.
landing.featureOfflineBody: Picks queue up and sync automatically when the signal returns.
landing.featureLiveBody: Stock changed on one phone appears on the supervisor dashboard within a second.
landing.featureSheetsBody: Sheets is a read window and a master-data editor — not the primary database.
landing.how1: Find the item on the dashboard to see its rack location.
landing.how2: Scan the rack QR — the phone camera is enough.
landing.how3: Enter quantity and reason. Stock updates and is logged under your name.

login.title: Sign in to Nemu
login.subtitle: Use the employee code and PIN from your warehouse admin.
login.googleDisabled: Google is not enabled by the admin
login.forgotPin: Forgot your PIN? Ask the admin to reset it. Worker sessions last 8 hours.
login.errorLocked: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
login.errorRemaining: {count} attempts left before a temporary lock.
login.sessionExpired: Session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.nextNotice: Sign in to continue to the page you opened.
login.invalidNext: That destination is not valid, so you were sent to the dashboard.

take.title: Pick item
take.woRequired: This reason requires a work order number.
take.qtyDecimal: This unit does not use decimals.
take.focusHint: Quantity is selected. Tap the number or use +1/+5/+10.
take.sessionExpiredDraft: Session ended. Your draft is saved and will be restored after you sign in.
take.offlineQueued: No signal. The pick is queued and will be sent automatically.
take.errorGeneric: Could not send the pick. Try again.
take.insufficientBody: Rack stock is now {available} {unit}. Adjust the quantity and send again.
take.raceNotice: Stock changed while you were filling the form. Latest numbers loaded.
take.itemMismatchTitle: This isn't the item you were looking for
take.emptyStockBody: Nothing to pick here. Tell a supervisor so the rack is counted or refilled.

confirm.title: Recorded
confirm.noCustody: The pick is recorded and treated as used.
confirm.cancelled: Pick undone. Rack stock is back to what it was.
confirm.cancelFailed: Undo failed. The 60 second window has passed.
confirm.promptTitle: How many are left on the rack now?
confirm.promptBlindTitle: How many are left on the rack?
confirm.promptDifferentBody: The system records {system} {unit}. The variance goes to the supervisor queue; stock does not change automatically.
confirm.promptInconclusive: Stock changed before your answer arrived. Recorded as inconclusive, not a variance.
confirm.promptError: Could not send the answer. Try again.
confirm.promptQuota: This shift's question quota is used up.

custody.title: What I'm carrying
custody.emptyBody: Items you pick appear here until they are marked used or returned.
custody.emptyTeam: Nobody on the team is carrying anything.
custody.closeAllBody: Every entry will be marked used with the same work order. You can adjust later from history.
custody.settleBody: Machine and work order come from the pick. You can change them.
custody.settleDamagedHint: This goes to the supervisor review queue.
custody.returnBody: Scan the destination rack QR to confirm the location.
custody.reminderBody: Close them now so stock doesn't become shadow stock.
custody.shiftOverAnnounce: Shift has ended. You are still carrying {count} items.

scan.title: Scan QR
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR on the rack or locker.
scan.manualLabel: Type the code from the label
scan.recentEmpty: No scans on this device yet.
scan.permissionBody: You can still use a manual code or upload a photo of the QR.
scan.permissionChrome: In Chrome: tap the lock icon in the address bar → Site settings → Camera → Allow, then reload.
scan.permissionSafari: In Safari iOS: Settings → Safari → Camera → Ask/Allow, then reload.
scan.permissionFirefox: In Firefox: tap the camera icon in the address bar → Blocked → Allow.
scan.uploadHint: Pick a photo of the QR label from your gallery.
scan.notSupported: This browser cannot scan with the camera yet. Use a manual code.
scan.invalidCode: Unknown code. Check the label again.
scan.error: Camera failed to start. Try again or use a manual code.
scan.insecureBody: Browsers only allow camera access on https:// or localhost. Because this app is opened over http:// with an IP address, the browser blocks the camera — the app is not broken. You can still upload a QR photo below, or type the code manually.

history.title: My history
history.subtitle: Every pick and return under your name.
history.emptyBody: Every pick you send is recorded here, permanently.
history.reverseBody: The original row stays. Undo creates a reversal row and restores stock.
history.reverseWindowClosed: The 60 second undo window has passed. Ask your supervisor.
history.idempotentNote: Transactions cannot be edited or deleted.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: Every transaction, immutable.
transactions.searchPlaceholder: Search item, user, or work order…
transactions.emptyBody: Change the filter or date range to see other data.

opname.title: Counts & variances
opname.subtitle: Count physically, review variances, approve corrections.
opname.newSessionBody: Pick a zone. Every rack in that zone is added to the count list.
opname.blindHint: System quantity is hidden from counters.
opname.emptyBody: Create a session to start counting physical stock per zone.
opname.emptyVarianceBody: Variances from "Different" answers appear here for approval.
opname.emptyNeedsCountBody: Every rack was verified within the last 90 days.
opname.approveBody: The system creates an adjustment transaction for every approved variance.
opname.rejectBody: A reason is required. Stock does not change.
opname.crossConfirm: Two different variances on the same rack within 7 days.
opname.createFromNeeds: Create a session from this list
opname.noLines: This session has no lines yet.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Usage, stock confidence, and custody.
reports.trendBody: Outgoing quantity per period from the rollup table.
reports.deadStockEmpty: No dead stock in this range.

database.title: Database
database.subtitle: Validated master data, like a modern spreadsheet.
database.readOnly: You have read-only access. Ask an admin to make changes.
database.drawerHint: Changes save when you press Save.
database.deactivateBody: The item disappears from search and cannot be picked. You can reactivate it anytime.
database.qtyReadOnly: Quantity only changes through transactions or counts.
database.emptyBody: Add the first row or import from CSV.
database.emptyUsersBody: Add a worker with an initial PIN, or bulk import from CSV.
database.emptyLabelsBody: Pick items and a size preset to print QR labels.
database.inlineEditHint: Click a cell to edit inline.
database.pinOnce: The initial PIN is shown once. Write it down and hand it over.
database.cannotDeleteHasStock: Location still holds stock — deactivated, not deleted.
database.duplicateSku: SKU already used by another item.
database.newItemHint: The QR code is generated automatically.
database.newLocationHint: Locations follow the hierarchy: warehouse › zone › rack › bin.

labels.title: QR labels
labels.subtitle: Pick items, pick a size, print.
labels.previewHint: Print at 100%. QR uses error correction level Q.
labels.markDamagedDone: Label marked damaged. The code stays the same.
labels.errorCustomSize: Size must be between 20 and 210 mm.
labels.printHint: Print at 100% scale without "fit to page" so the QR stays scannable.
labels.emptyLabelsBody: Import items first or change the search, then pick items to build QR labels.

imports.title: Import & export
imports.subtitle: Preview first, apply when sure.
imports.dropBody: or choose a file. Maximum 5,000 rows.
imports.tooLarge: The file exceeds 5,000 rows. Split it into several files.
imports.invalidFile: The file cannot be read. Make sure it is CSV or XLSX.
imports.dryRunNote: Nothing is written to the database until you press Apply.
imports.errorsNote: {count} rows were rejected and will not be applied.
imports.exportBody: Download all master data as a single Excel file (one sheet per type).

admin.verifyEnabledHint: When off, the pick flow is unchanged.
admin.verifyThresholdHint: No prompt when rack stock is above this number.
admin.accentHint: Colors that fail AA contrast are rejected.
admin.googleSubtitle: Drive and Sheets as a read window, not the primary database.
admin.googleDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect Google Drive? Sync stops until you reconnect.
admin.googleCheckError: Schema mismatch. Run the template migration.
admin.googleSetupHint: Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET before connecting.

palette.placeholder: Search items or jump to a page…

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: This section failed to load. The rest of the page still works.
errors.pageBody: An error occurred while loading this page.
errors.notFoundBody: This address doesn't exist. It may have moved.
errors.offlineBody: Changes are stored on the device and sent when the signal returns.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this page.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

setup.title: Initial setup
setup.subtitle: Six steps to get the warehouse ready. All doable in one session.
setup.alreadyDone: Setup was completed before. You can redo any step.
setup.orgError: Could not save the organisation name.
setup.stepOrgBody: This name appears in the Google Drive folder and report titles.
setup.stepAdminBody: Make sure at least one active admin account exists with a PIN only its owner knows.
setup.stepLocationsBody: Build the warehouse → zone → rack → bin hierarchy. QR codes are printed per rack or bin.
setup.stepItemsBody: Upload a CSV, review new/changed/rejected rows, then apply.
setup.stepLabelsBody: Pick items, choose a size, download a print-ready PDF.
setup.stepGoogleBody: Sheets is a read window. The system works fully without Google.
setup.finishDone: Setup complete. Have a good shift.
setup.finishHint: Optional steps can be done any time from the admin menu.

offline.title: Offline queue
offline.subtitle: Picks recorded while the signal dropped. Sent automatically when back online.
offline.syncFailed: Could not send the queue. Try again.
offline.emptyBody: Every pick has been sent. Nothing left behind.
offline.note: Idempotency keys make resending safe: no duplicate transactions.
offline.flagOffBody: Enable NEXT_PUBLIC_FLAGS=offline to turn on the on-device queue.
